body:
did you know: the week reputation came out, it outsold every other album on the billboard 200 combined.

1.216 million copies in pure sales in seven days -- the biggest sales week for any album in over two years -- while the #2 record that week managed 66,000. no streaming for the entire first week. no press interviews. a wiped-clean social feed and a black-and-white snake as the whole rollout.

it also put her in a club that was only ever hers: four different million-selling album weeks (speak now, red, 1989, and now reputation). no other artist in nielsen history has even one week that big four times.

for a record she launched by going quiet, the number said the loud part out loud: they showed up anyway.

longlivets.com
why: Did-you-know / era-deep-cut on reputation, a cold era -- nothing in recent posted/ or queue/ has touched reputation (recent mix: 1989, folklore, showgirl, debut, speak now, evermore, and the queued red), so it's the thinnest-covered corner, and there's no exact Aug-7 on-this-day Vault match. Every claim traces to the Vault reputation item 'reputation sells more than the rest of the chart combined' (sourced Billboard + Refinery29 + Forbes): 1.216M pure sales week one, biggest sales week for any album since 2015, the #2 album (Sam Smith) at 66,000, outselling the rest of the Billboard 200 combined (Forbes headline), the streaming holdout / no-press / wiped-feed rollout, and the four-million-selling-weeks Nielsen record (Speak Now 1.047M, Red 1.208M, 1989 1.287M, reputation). Chart/business lore only -- outside every #36/Clownbot blocklist topic. Media: /eras/reputation.png (committed, deployed era tile). Scheduled 08-07 23:00 to hold the evening cadence a day after the red item.
